messages:
sara: anybody seeing a spike of 503s for hosted inference? multiple customers complaining since 08:12 PST. looks correlated to upstream worker exits during model prefetch. request_id=6f3a2c7

josh: oncall here — can you paste a sample worker log and the container exit code?

sara: small log from runner: 
```
[2026-03-17T08:11:59Z] INFO prefetch: start prefetch model=redwood-2-large shard=3 req=6f3a2c7
[2026-03-17T08:12:01Z] ERROR runtime: cuda runtime error: device-side assert triggered, aborting (0x800700??)
[2026-03-17T08:12:01Z] FATAL signal: SIGSEGV (core dumped)
exit code 139
```

infra-bot: detected container exit: runner-hosted-xy-7f8; exit_code=139; restart_count=1; last_restart=2026-03-17T08:12:02Z

laura: SIGSEGV during prefetch + device assert usually points at either a kernel bug or corrupt KV prefetch pointer. which model & quantization? any recent model swaps?

sara: model=redwood-2-qlora-8bit, quantized last night (2026-03-16 23:40 UTC). nvidia driver on that host: 535.86.05. nvidia-smi around crash: 
```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| GPU 0: Tesla A100-SXM4 (UUID: GPU-abc)
| Processes: 1  python3 (pid 4217)  GPU memory 40.1 GiB / 40.1 GiB
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

kevin: that looks like full gpu memory at crash. could be OOM hitting device assertion then segfault. did the prefetch try to allocate an extra KV shard? any change to prefetch window size?

josh: checking recent deploys — we rolled a small prefetch micro-optim on 2026-03-16 23:35 UTC (PR #4271) that tweaks async prefetch alignment. rolling that back as a quick test would be easy. also we should throttle large context prefetch for hosted tier until we confirm.

sara: customer impact: 3 customers reporting 503s in last 10m, highest qps for one tenant ~120 rps. customers saw transient 503 + "upstream inference error". support already escalated to account team.

support-bot: incident created INC-2026-94: Hosted inference 503s due to upstream worker segfaults — link: https://tickets.redwood/INC-2026-94

laura: repro steps I want to capture: 1) send a long context (~32k tokens) with prefetch_enabled=true to a shared shard host 2) monitor nvidia-smi and /tmp/runner-core.* 3) capture coredump and gdb bt. quick curl: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-2-qlora-8bit","prefetch":true,"input":"'$(python -c 'print("x "*32000)')'"}'
```

josh: I'll trigger the curl against a repro host i set up and attach gdb if it crashes. in the meantime mitigation: add fallback routing rule to send requests >16k tokens to the smaller variant redwood-2-qlora-8bit-lowmem and set max_context=16000 for hosted default. I can flip the feature flag: 
```
./adminctl rollout set-route --name hosted-default --fallback redwood-2-qlora-8bit-lowmem --max_context 16000
```

kevin: also recommend temporarily disabling async prefetch alignment: 
```
kubectl -n hosted set env deployment/runner PRELOAD_ASYNC_ALIGN=false
```
we should watch for reduced memory pressure.

infra-bot: alert: routing fallback applied to hosted-default, rollout_id=rl-9981

laura: collect coredump using `coredumpctl dump --no-frames -o /tmp/runner-core.dump` and then `gdb -batch -ex "thread apply all bt" -ex "quit" /usr/bin/runner /tmp/runner-core.dump > /tmp/runner-backtrace.txt` — paste backtrace here. capture `/var/log/runner/prefetch.log` too.

sara: pushed customer comms: short note to affected tenants that we're investigating and applied temporary routing fallback; ETA for full fix TBD.

josh: initial repro hit — got SIGSEGV with same pattern. stack shows prefetch::copy_kv -> deviceAlloc -> illegal memory access. attaching condensed bt: 
```
#0  0x00007fabc123 in prefetch::copy_kv at prefetch.cc:142
#1  0x00007fabc456 in ModelPrefetch::start at prefetch.cc:78
#2  0x0000555b9 in worker_main at worker.cpp:331
```

kevin: plan of action: (1) keep fallback routing + max_context cap (2) roll back PR #4271 to confirm blame (3) collect and analyze core + driver interaction (4) hotfix with bounds check on prefetch and enforce prefetch mem reservation. i'll own (2) & (4).

laura: also schedule a driver-verification job against 535.86.05 and previous 535.54 to rule out regression.

support-bot: updated INC-2026-94 with action items and customer list.

sara: thanks all — i'll keep the thread updated with customer updates. small ask: if anyone sees reproducer that doesn't require 32k tokens, ping here — we want the smallest repro. :pray:

josh: noted. rolling back PR now and will post results in ~10m. :wrench:

kevin: created follow-up ticket ENG-4271-rollback + QA job.

sara: confirmed customer 1 saw 503s stop after fallback routing applied. monitoring for recurrence. :thumbsup:
